fieldNotes.location: Roster coordinates (43.87584,-85.509751, ROOFTOP, moved only 16m) correctly landed on the General Mills Yoplait yogurt plant at 128 E Slosson Ave, Reed City MI. Locked center 43.8756,-85.5087.
fieldNotes.facility: Active General Mills facility - the Yoplait yogurt manufacturing plant in downtown Reed City. A dense process plant (visible silos, tanks, pipe racks) plus a separate NE cooler/warehouse and drop yard.
fieldNotes.truckGate: The truck/dock yard on the N side of the plant appears to have perimeter fencing, and the NE drop yard is a defined trailer-storage lot. However the N approach from the public street is fairly open with no clearly visible barrier arm, swing/sliding gate, or guard booth at the property line in any Street View (2018, 2021, 2024). Set true as a defined fenced truck yard but LOW CONFIDENCE - flagged.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth identified at any entrance in available Street View. Flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Set true - fenced truck/dock yard without a confirmed staffed booth. Low confidence, flagged.
fieldNotes.drivewayShort: The plant fronts directly on downtown streets; the gate-to-dock approach is short (1-2 trucks) - this is a compact, tightly-packed urban-core plant footprint.
fieldNotes.backupSensitive: Plant sits in the middle of downtown Reed City, hemmed by storefronts, streets and residential blocks; a truck queue at the dock approach would quickly spill onto public streets - backup-sensitive.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: N-side dock bank shows roughly 6-10 trailers backed in plus dock structures; banded 10-25. Some dock doors may be obscured by process equipment - flagged.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Large NE drop yard holds roughly 30-40 parked trailers, plus more staged near the dock - banded 25-50.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Dedicated NE trailer-storage lot, clearly separate from the active dock apron.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Two building clusters: the main yogurt plant and a separate NE cooler/warehouse building serving the drop yard.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock activity concentrated on the N face of the main plant; the NE building is used mainly for trailer storage/cold storage - treated as a single ship/receive dock cluster.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Reed City is a small rural Michigan town (~2,400 people); per the rubric's small-town guidance, classified Rural despite the downtown-adjacent setting.
fieldNotes.railServed: No active rail spur visible entering the plant; the corridor NE near the Hersey River is a rail-trail / recreation path (Reed City Crossroads), not active freight rail into the property.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Perimeter box ~34 acres covering the main plant plus the NE drop yard and warehouse.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale identified in imagery - flagged uncertain.

citations.claim: GM completed sale of US yogurt business to Lactalis; divestiture includes the Reed City, Mich. manufacturing facility
GM agreement to sell NA yogurt business to Lactalis/Sodiaal; names Reed City, Mich. plant among facilities transferring

verification.rationale: Reed City is a Yoplait yogurt plant explicitly named in the Lactalis divestiture; sale completed June 30, 2025, so now Lactalis (Midwest Yogurt), not GM.
